lead_headline: Nothing over $4M on the foreclosure front — but restaurant tracker logs 4 new leads today, including Dairy Queen and CPK closures finally confirmed.

restaurant.blurb: 4 leads today — Soho Hibachi Express shuttered (West Colfax), both lingering Dairy Queen (Regis) and CPK Cherry Creek closures now confirmed, plus California Pizza Kitchen closure officially logged across multiple neighborhoods.

liquor.blurb: Still nothing — zero applications filed marks seventh straight business day without activity, breaking into uncharted territory. Weekly count locked at 5, down 94% from prior week's 8 (which was itself 91% below the preceding 93). Month closes with sustained drought: post-maintenance processing has settled into minimal baseline with no sign of recovery. State either batch-processing on longer cycles or fundamentally throttling intake. August's first week will reveal whether this is structural shift or anomalous lull.

reputation.blurb: 40 mentions this week across 12 sources — down 49% from prior week's 79, marking sharpest weekly decline since June. Instagram held lead at 14 citations (35% share), followed by Facebook (9), Denver Post (5), Reddit (3). Building Salt Lake picked up Alterra ski headquarters story; Denver Post covered Fire on the Mountain TAG Burger replacement; Union Station preservation content sustained social engagement. Week averaged 5.7 mentions/day vs. prior 11.3 — steep drop suggests summer slowdown or post-peak normalization. YTD 1,167 total from 111 sources.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (3 new, 3 canceled) — fourth consecutive day without net growth keeps MTD at −16 (−0.5/day), 90-day at +92. Last two weeks show divergent pattern: prior seven posted +16 net on mid-week surges (11 new on 7/23, 10 on 7/28); latest seven flat despite healthy acquisition pace. July remains weakest month since March, but recent stability suggests floor established rather than continued erosion. YTD +210 (+1.0/day) intact — August must deliver meaningful positive net to offset July shortfall and preserve annual trajectory.
